title: geranium dissectum f. roseum
intro: Geranium dissectum f. roseum, commonly known as Rose Geranium, is a flowering plant species in the geranium family, known for its delicate, pink or white flowers and attractive foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress levels, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Rose Geranium include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as geraniol, linalool, and citronellol. These constituents have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, contributing to the plant's therapeutic actions and health benefits.
